children.value: > Fact From Story Nike reported revenue Thursday that fell short of Wall Street's sales expectations for the first time in two years, but it beat on earnings and gross margin estimates, sending its stock soaring in after-hours trading.
> > Fact From Story Nike shares rose about 8% in extended trading Thursday.

> > > Fact From Story The company's reported net income for the three-month period that ended August 31 was $1.45 billion, or 94 cents per share, compared with $1.47 billion, or 93 cents per share, a year earlier.
> > > Fact From Story Nike beat on earnings and gross margin estimates.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge Earnings and net income are indicators of a company's financial performance.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Stock prices rise when investors react positively to news about the company.
> Commonsense Knowledge When a company beats on earnings and gross margin estimates, this is good news for the company.
